Overview

Saga is a city in with a population of 235,000. A quiet prefectural capital on Kyushu known for its pottery traditions, hot springs, and relaxed pace of life. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
